reuse.why: The link handler is a thin call into the existing linkBankSyncAccount helper and the sync path reuses processBankSyncDownload's balance logic, but the download function is a fresh copy rather than shared code.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response shaping), adding one more copy of an already-repeated block.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts and the account type under types/models, exactly where the tree places each provider's pieces.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra; the two desktop-client edits are forced by extending the SYNC_PROVIDERS union and are minimal.

maintainability.why: Easy to own and consistent with the other providers; the copied download function adds to an existing maintenance burden.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking goes through linkBankSyncAccount; no existing shared download helper is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied downloadFintegraTransactions is an open, verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised.
